ChainRef.description: A chain as the config names it.

Transfer.description: The warp transfer the message carries.

recipient.description: The receiving account as the destination writes it: bech32 on Celestia, 20-byte hex on EVM.

recipientHex.description: The same account as a 32-byte Hyperlane address.

amount.description: Base units of the token, decimal.

Dispatch.description: The origin transaction that sent the message.

anyOf.description: The account that sent the transaction.

Verified.description: When the tracker saw the ISM cover the message.

ismHeight.description: The ISM height that covered it.

Delivery.description: When the destination mailbox processed the message.

anyOf.description: Our delivery transaction; null when someone else delivered it or it predates the tracker.

Failure.description: A refused delivery, parked and retried with backoff.

anyOf.description: The last failed transaction, if one landed.

Links.description: Explorer links, where the chain has an explorer configured.

Notification.description: One problem. Opens when its condition first holds, updates while it holds, resolves by itself when it clears. It cannot be dismissed.

key.description: The condition; at most one open notification per key. Kinds: message-overdue, message-failed, route-failing, route-silent, route-staged, ism-unreadable, watch-failing, wallet-low, wallet-unreadable, monitor-silent.

subjectId.description: The message id, route name or chain name.

anyOf.description: Unix seconds, or null while open.

Message.description: A transfer on one of our routes, from dispatch to delivery.

firstSeenAt.description: When the tracker first recorded it. Unix seconds.

anyOf.description: Unix seconds when the route first reported an origin head at or past the dispatch block, or null.

status.description: Where the transfer is. `pending`: dispatched, not yet covered by the ISM, within its route's expected latency. `verified`: covered by the ISM, delivery next. `delivered`: processed by the destination mailbox. `failed`: the destination refused delivery; parked and retried. `overdue`: stuck, see `problem`.

anyOf.description: What it waits on, while pending or verified.
What is wrong, when failed or overdue.

MessagePage.description: A page of transfers, problems first, then newest first.

SearchResult.description: Transfers matching a message id, transaction hash, or account on either side.

IsmReading.description: The route's ISM as the tracker last read it.

OriginHead.description: How far the route loop last found the origin could go.

Failing.description: The route loop's current run of failures.

Staged.description: An attested batch still being submitted.

Route.description: One route: its ISM, its loop, its transfers and its open problems.

status.description: `ok`: nothing open. `degraded`: a warning is open. `down`: a critical notification is open.

expectedLatencySecs.description: Past this a transfer is overdue.

notifications.description: Open notifications about the route, its transfers, its origin watch, or the monitor.

Watch.description: The tracker's watch on an origin.

status.description: `ok`: nothing open. `degraded`: a warning is open. `down`: a critical notification is open.

anyOf.description: When the monitor last ran, or null.

Inbox.description: Notifications: open first, most severe first, newest first; then resolved ones.

Wallet.description: The relayer's gas wallet on one destination chain, read every 5 minutes.

anyOf.description: The relayer's account on this chain.
Whole tokens a day over the last week; null with under 6h of readings.

level.description: `low` below lowAt or under 7 days left; `critical` empty or under 2 days; `unknown` not read yet.

anyOf.description: Address page on the chain's explorer.

Venue.description: Uniswap v3 on one chain, and its token factory.

fee.description: The fee tier of every pool here, in hundredths of a basis point

TradeChain.description: A chain trades can start or end on.

domain.description: Hyperlane domain; for an EVM chain also its chain id

venue.description: Its pool, if it has one

TradeAsset.description: An asset and where it is.

id.description: The symbol for TIA and teeUSD, the hub token id for a launched token. Use it wherever an asset is named

routers.description: Chain name to warp router: a token id on the hub, the ERC20 itself on an EVM chain

launcher.description: The EVM account that launched it

pools.description: Chain name to its pool against the quote asset, where one holds liquidity

hub.description: The Celestia chain every route goes through

quoteAsset.description: What every pool is quoted in and multi-hop swaps route through

refreshedAt.description: When launches and pools were last read

Step.description: One step of a route. A swap has from = to; a bridge has sell = buy.

etaSecs.description: Typical wait for the whole route

BuildRequest.description: One step to turn into transactions.

amount.description: Base units; the step's amountIn when absent

sender.description: Who signs: an EVM address, or a bech32 account for a step leaving the hub

recipient.description: Who receives a bridge on the far side; required for a bridge

slippageBps.description: How far below the quote a swap may fill; default 50

Tx.description: An unsigned transaction. evm fills chainId, to, data and value; cosmos fills msgs, which go in one transaction in order.

Build.description: The transactions for one step, to sign and send in order.

minOut.description: Base units; a swap reverts below this

CosmosMsg.description: One message of a hub transaction.

value.description: The message in proto JSON field names

amountB.description: Base units; sets a new pool's price, ignored for an existing one

sender.description: The EVM account that provides it and owns the position

PoolResult.description: The transactions to add it, in order.

pool.description: Null when this creates the pool

amountB.description: What the pool's price asks for, on an existing pool

owner.description: The bech32 account that signs every hub step and receives the supply

hubToken.description: The id the create step's EventCreateSyntheticToken reported

chains.description: Default: every chain with a factory

supply.description: The whole supply, base units at 6 decimals

launcher.description: The EVM account that sent the deploys

Candidate.description: A router a factory made for a hub token.
